units_and_coordinate_evidence.depth: Stored uint16 × scene_camera.depth_scale gives millimeters; zero means no valid measurement.
units_and_coordinate_evidence.pose: R_m2c * X_model_mm + t_m2c_mm gives camera coordinates; cam_K projects them. Models and translations use mm.
units_and_coordinate_evidence.model_frame: Official models use natural upright +Z model coordinates and bbox-centered origins. Source real model-native axes are not proof of pallet semantic/native8 correspondence.
units_and_coordinate_evidence.mask: IMID_GTID indexes scene_gt list; GTID is not object class ID. Visible/full source rasters are silhouettes, not per-corner semantic D/E/S.

missing_or_uncertified: Full object mesh is not present in this intake; only official model AABB bounds were newly extracted. No first-hit mesh renderer equivalence is established.
No official camera-dynamic native8 keypoint visibility annotation is present. A virtual cuboid can be constructed as a declared weak geometric teacher, but its corners need not lie on real surfaces.
Invalid scene depth exists, including625 visible-mask pixels for this first instance; ray estimates must retain UNKNOWN/interval uncertainty.
A constant-cuboid-point-depth ring test is distinct from the original synthetic first-hit ray/occluder test. It must not be renamed exact semantic external visibility.
Actual initializer-production q is not established by GT-jitter emulation. Any such q distribution is source-supervised/emulated and must be declared.
feasibility_statement: The actual official scene depth, target instance masks, GT object pose, K and exact model AABB are sufficient inputs to test one source-only virtual-reference proxy. They do not certify physical corner semantics, reliable native8 correspondence, or solve real pallet visibility. The label agent owns the separate one-instance normal-order/ray-proxy calculation.
